status: experimental (2026-10-14, branch feature/w2k-acpi-csmen): the release binary in test builds since then; installer/cmd/usos-efisign/release.go stages it with the source archive, the seven patches and the licence notices; tools/xp_csmwrap_esp.sh and the BIOS Core DOS installer pin its hash
naming: 3.1.2-usos6 = 3.1.2-usos5 + patch 0007 (diagnostic ACPI enable before the legacy boot, Windows 2000 ACPI flow only). Earlier: usos5 = usos4 + patch 0006 (ACPI 1.0 view), usos4 = usos3 + patch 0005, usos3 = usos1 + patch 0004.
modified: MODIFIED version of CSMWrap 3.1.2 and of its SeaBIOS fork: quiet boot unless csmwrap.ini sets verbose = true (patches 0001-0003, as in 3.1.2-usos1), and SeaBIOS CSM boot priorities looked up in CSMWrap's BBS table by PCI address, USB mass storage included (patch 0004, 2026-09-29); the exact disk CSMWrap was loaded from becomes BIOS drive 0x80 also when other disks share its controller (patch 0005, 2026-10-11: CSMWrap tags its BBS entry with an FNV-1a hash of its sector 0, SeaBIOS moves the matching hard disk first, the others keep their order); and an ACPI 1.0 view for legacy systems on CSMWrap's RSDP copy (patch 0006, 2026-10-13: RsdtAddress 0 / invalid RSDT / RSDT without the FACP or APIC the XSDT lists -> a new RSDT from the XSDT entries below 4 GiB; FADT 32-bit FIRMWARE_CTRL/DSDT/PM/GPE fields 0 with the X_ field set below 4 GiB -> a FADT copy with them filled, referenced from the RSDT only; csmwrap.ini acpi_legacy_fadt = true (written only for Windows 2000 with ACPI) -> the RSDT FADT is always a copy cut to revision 1 / 116 bytes, because the 2000 ACPI HALs copy FADT.Length bytes into a 0x84-byte buffer; with the same option the RSDT's DSDT/SSDTs are copies whose static resource templates have QWord windows above 4 GiB cleared, because the 2000 acpi.sys truncates a QWord Length to 32 bits and stops with STOP 0xA5 (0x2) in its PCI root window check; a valid 1.0 view without the option is left untouched; logged as "USOS ACPI10"); and, only with the same csmwrap.ini acpi_legacy_fadt = true, a legacy-to-ACPI-mode transition as the last step before Legacy16Boot (patch 0007, 2026-10-14, diagnostic: RTC A/B read, FADT ACPI_ENABLE written to SMI_CMD when PM1a_CNT.SCI_EN is 0, SCI_EN polled for at most 3 s on the PM timer, RTC A/B read again; 8 result bytes at physical 0x4F4 (BDA inter-application communication area) for usosvid; logged as "USOS ACPIEN")

source_archive.note: unpatched 3.1.2 tree with all submodules and seabios/.version (shared with 3.1.2-usos1); the usos3 source is this archive plus patches/*.patch applied in order with patch -p1

upstream_rebuild.note: the same source and toolchain built WITHOUT patches in each run: matches 3.1.2-usos1/manifest.json upstream_rebuild

build.repeatable: one VM run on 2026-10-14 (tools/csmwrap_build/run_build_vm.py --patches 3.1.2-usos6/patches --usos-version 3.1.2-usos6, same lock as usos5) building usos6 twice from fresh trees: identical binaries; the unpatched build still matches upstream_rebuild
